propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider output to an empty result that is incorrectly treated as a valid review outcome
Semantically empty verification responses (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must never produce a valid pass or valid empty review
The verification kernel must distinguish via telemetry between clean parses, recovered parses, empty outcomes, and unrecoverable responses
Decision layer already enforces indeterminate outcome for any finding with no verification entry, regardless of whether absence came from raw-empty or malformed-to-empty path
Flexible tolerant parsing and provider-independent recovery behavior must be preserved while rejecting empty normalized results
Pipeline-level telemetry wiring in plan_review_decide and code_review_decide requires separate follow-up work to emit outcome_counts
